title: Officer demands cash or an inflated amount
officerCan: Compound a compoundable offence, if notified for it, at the prescribed amount.
Accept payment through the official channel and issue a receipt.
officerCannot: Set an amount that is not the prescribed one.
Take money without a receipt or challan.
Insist on cash when a formal challan is available.

quotableLine.en: I would like to pay through the official challan so that I have a receipt.
quotableLine.hi: मैं आधिकारिक चालान के ज़रिए भुगतान करना चाहता हूँ ताकि मेरे पास रसीद हो।

doNotSay: Are you asking for a bribe?
Any direct accusation of corruption at the roadside.
documentNow: The exact amount asked for, in the officer's own words, and whether a receipt was offered.

options.label: Ask for a receipt or challan for whatever amount is paid.
options.rationale: A demand that cannot survive a receipt is the thing worth recording.

options.label: Offer to pay by the official digital route.
options.rationale: Removes the cash element without accusing anyone.
options.tradeoff: May not be available at that location.

options.label: Pay, keep the recording, and complain afterwards through the proper authority.
options.rationale: Ends the encounter, preserves the evidence.
options.tradeoff: You are out of pocket until the complaint succeeds.

verification.notes: Placeholder from PRD table. Not checked against bare act. Needs advocate sign-off for legal accuracy AND for escalation risk (PRD R3).
